title: •Jabba’s Influence
caption: •Jabba’s Influence (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your gangsters are information brokers. Your bounty hunters (except Boba Fett) are power +1. While Xizor on table, Scum And Villainy ignores Emperor. Once per game, if Jabba at Audience Chamber, may ▼ a non-bounty hunter alien. {alter}
lore: Jabba makes offers one cannot refuse. Smugglers, thieves and competitors who do not acquiesce have been rumored to wake up with a bantha’s head in their bed.

notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip's heading and caption (Jabba’s); wiki page title uses a straight one. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. The slip prints ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in bantha’s (wiki straight). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line is the Special Edition form, '1998' legible. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1-D-jabbasinfluence-pre.gif, 350 px).
